extracted.name: Rocky Road
extracted.description: These no-bake rocky road treats are easy to make with melted chocolate and peanut butter and have lots of gooey marshmallows in every bite.
instruction_lines: Heat chocolate chips and peanut butter over low heat in a medium saucepan until chocolate has completely melted. Remove from heat. Stir in marshmallows.
Pour chocolate and marshmallow mixture into prepared pan; cool in the refrigerator until set, at least 1 hour. Cut into squares and enjoy!
